finalText:
All 4 tests pass now.

**Root cause:** `src/jobs/processOrder.js:6-11` acquired a connection but only released it after `run()` succeeded — no try/finally. Every rejected order (`invalid order payload`) permanently leaked one connection. Worker log shows exactly this: each failure bumps `pool in-use` and it never drops, until 5/5 at 02:06:30, exhaustion errors follow, worker exits at 02:06:35 — the 2am page.

**Fix:** wrapped the `run()` call in try/finally so `pool.release(conn)` always runs, matching what `src/handlers/api.js` already did correctly via `withConnection`.

Next: deploy this and watch `pool in-use` in the worker logs stay bounded through the next batch of bad orders.
